hints.hint: Security misconfigurations often stem from leaving default credentials, sample files, or server diagnostic options enabled.
Check if default administrative credentials like admin:admin work on the login page, or inspect exposed debug routes listed in the portal.
The /backups/ route has directory browsing enabled. Web servers without disabled indexing display a list of all downloadable files.
Download /backups/backup_config.json.bak and examine the 'admin_system_key' property inside the JSON payload.
